name: The Merged Branch
basis: Static default-branch source and test audit; not a browser playtest, construction inspection or legal compliance certificate
nccAsAtDate: NCC 2022 Amendment 2 (NSW, effective 2025-07-29); NSW NCC 2025 planned commencement 2027-05-01
provisionalBuildingClassification: NCC NSW Class 6 hospitality bar/dining; confirm ancillary/mixed classification and actual approvals

S01.title: How to comply with NCC: NSW current edition 2022 Amendment 2, 29 July 2025; 2025 deferred to May 2027

S02.title: NCC 2022 Volume One NSW Class 6, Parts B/C/D/E/F/G/J; building classification applies by use

S03.title: AS 1851-2012 inspection/testing from 13 February 2026 and FSS/AFSS obligations

S04.title: Cafes, restaurants and retail outlets: 3.2.3, AS 4674, premises and inspection

S05.title: Hand-washing requirements: dedicated warm potable handwash and adjoining WCs

S06.title: Standard 3.2.2A: supervisor, food handler training, showing food safe

S07.title: Hotel licence: free water/food, posted hotel licence/licensee, minors restrictions, training and trading hours

S08.title: Retail food businesses including bars and hotels must register with Council; planning and inspection

S09.title: Liquid trade waste must have written Section 68 approval

S10.title: Plumbing Code of Australia NCC Volume Three applies to NSW plumbing/drainage

S11.title: Underage drinking: venue authorisations and age controls

S12.title: Gaming machine layout, separation and restricted access if gambling machines are added

S14.title: Liquor Plan of Management: free water, ID checks, RSA and service conditions

S15.title: NCC 2025 adoption in NSW deferred to May 2027

checks.title: Classification, use, approval and building age
checks.sourceObservation: site is named pub, has bar and dining; no classified floor plan, approved use, DA/CC/OC or prior approval date in audited scene
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Assess NSW Class 6 pub/bar and any mixed Class 9b/3 or other uses, approvals and which NCC edition applies to each construction stage; never claim retrospective universal obligation

checks.title: Exterior-to-interior dimensions and storeys
checks.sourceObservation: townlife.js pub facade 14 m wide × 11 m deep × ~7 m high with two glazing bands, vs interior-kit 14 m × 18 m single walkable room/4.7 m ceiling
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Reconcile game coordinate transforms, rear walls, accessible upper floor or remove upper floor cues, roof/building height and consistent fire envelope

checks.title: Occupant capacity and seating/loads
checks.sourceObservation: three four-seat bistro tables, six bar stools and sofa/chairs; no occupancy certificate, staff/dynamic-crowd capacity
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Determine patron/staff occupancy and floor area, occupancy-based amenities and egress; set enforceable in-game maximum if game-realistic

checks.title: Egress route, door swing and exit count
checks.sourceObservation: interior-kit has a front exitZone width 2.1 m and doors:[]; no rear fire exit; pub has central aisle furniture collision
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Compute path travel distance, exits number and distribution, swing, unobstructed clear widths, latch/hardware and final exit discharge for actual classification/occupancy, then implement accepted game geometry

checks.title: Emergency lighting and exit signs
checks.sourceObservation: ordinary point/hemisphere and decorative wall lighting visible; no tested exit sign, emergency luminaire, power failure or escape-route contrast model
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Add correctly located sign/lighting representations where NCC design requires; controlled blackout test, schedule/service references

checks.title: Essential fire safety measures
checks.sourceObservation: pub scene has fireplace and room lighting but no identified alarm/smoke detection, portable extinguishers, hose reels, sprinklers (if required), fire blanket or appropriate kitchen suppression
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Determine required measures from NCC, building size/use and fire safety schedule; render actual necessary components and demonstrate fault/inspection states, not blanket declare sprinkler requirement

checks.title: Fireplace, heat, flue and combustible finishes
checks.sourceObservation: open-looking decorative fireplace at side wall x≈−6.55 with nearby lounge furnishings; flue, hearth, clearances and combustion air unknown
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Check if appliance is real fuel or decorative; if fuelled, model hearth/flue/cowl, clearances, alarms and manufacturer fire-safety evidence; prevent impossible collision/ignition geometry

checks.title: Fire safety schedule and maintenance AS 1851
checks.sourceObservation: no building-specific fire safety schedule, routine inspection history, essential measures or annual fire safety statement evidence in gameplay files
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Add documentary record and simulated competent inspection only after identifying applicable measures; 13 Feb 2026 NSW change matters

checks.title: Accessible arrival, entrance and circulation
checks.sourceObservation: the kit provides a centre door gap and walkable spawn; threshold ramp, step-free path from footpath, turn space, AS 1428.1 clearances and tactile signs not assessed
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Measure full continuous accessible route and entrance; handle turn/counter reach, tables, pinch points and door hardware; obtain accessibility review

checks.title: Accessible WC and ambulant fixtures
checks.sourceObservation: pub-interior.js creates one room and no WC, washbasin or accessible stall
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Provide appropriate accessible/ambulant sanitary facilities after F4/D4 assessment with exact plans, circulation and fittings, no generic decorative toilet proof

checks.title: Public and staff sanitary fixture provision
checks.sourceObservation: no pub toilet cubicles, basins, urinals or separated patron/staff amenities in source
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Calculate fixtures against occupancy, use and mixed zones under NCC F4; model hygiene/privacy/availability and accessible provision

checks.title: Hot/cold water, waste drainage and backflow
checks.sourceObservation: no visible pub meter, handwash outlet, water heater, grease-waste pipe, traps, sewer lateral or backflow asset; town water is still aggregate
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Specify separate potable and trade-waste/drain fixtures, showers only if justified, backflow and hot-water service; connect actual water/sewer game system with conservation

checks.title: Actual enclosed commercial kitchen
checks.sourceObservation: menu interaction claims meals prepared with a kitchen, but pub scene has no cooking room, ovens, cooking benches or doors to kitchen; menu-only
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Build a working kitchen of credible scale and hygiene separation; model equipment work zones and path from food receiving through safe service

checks.title: Food preparation, warewashing and separation
checks.sourceObservation: no dedicated produce washing/food prep sinks, dishwashing/sanitising line, clean/dirty separation or documented temperature-safe benching
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Represent adequate prep, dedicated dishwashing/sanitising, hot potable supply, cleaners' sink and suitable impervious, washable materials; classify operations to choose required equipment

checks.title: Dedicated food handler wash stations
checks.sourceObservation: no kitchen/bar handwashing sink with warm running potable water, soap and single-use drying fixture
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Locate dedicated handwash access within appropriate food-handler work zone and near WCs, with training/operability rather than a generic shared bar sink

checks.title: Refrigeration and food cold chain
checks.sourceObservation: visual fridge and a slab labelled cold-room door; no walkable cool-room volume, thermometer, food storage zones, temperature logs or explicit pub power feed
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Add meaningful chiller/cold room/freezer storage, source-to-food service cold chain, measured/simulated temperatures and outage/recovery/unsafe-food disposal mechanics

checks.title: Kitchen exhaust and general ventilation
checks.sourceObservation: no hoods, exhaust ducts, roof termination, make-up air, kitchen ventilation interlock; decorative ceiling fans are not ventilation verification
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: If cooking appliances require it, size/install mechanical kitchen exhaust and make-up air and associated safe discharge/fire interfaces according to actual equipment/design; verify common ventilation requirements

checks.title: Trade waste, fat/oil/grease controls
checks.sourceObservation: no greasy waste drainage, grease arrestor, consent/permit or separate collection pathway
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Confirm if liquid trade-waste approval needed under Dubbo Section 68 requirements for documented kitchen operations; place accessible grease-treatment assets if specified

checks.title: Food refuse, recyclables, pest exclusion and cleaning
checks.sourceObservation: pub scene has menu and bar decoration but no sealed waste store, food/chemical segregation, pest barriers or cleaners' sink
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Design waste and recycling storage, non-food chemical store, service collection route, pest exclusion and safe mop-water discharge

checks.title: Site rainfall, drainage, roof and stormwater
checks.sourceObservation: pub exterior shell exists; no roof gutters/downpipes/site stormwater or surface drainage routing identified by this audit
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Connect to separately audited RT-SYS-004; verify runoff routes, weatherproofing, ground/finished floor levels and sewage separation

checks.title: Site-specific electrical circuits/switchboard/RCD
checks.sourceObservation: RTU-001 B:pub reports physicalServiceId:null, meterId:null, no distinct customer demand; interior lights callback power-aware only
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Map restaurant cooking/chiller/fan/equipment and essential lighting to metered circuits, isolators, RCD/earthing requirements and backup conditional, with load checks

checks.title: Cooking fuel/LPG/natural gas eligibility and safety
checks.sourceObservation: no selected cooking technology, gas regulators, fuel supply, ventilation appliance metadata or shutoff; cannot presume town reticulation
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Choose electric or legitimately sourced LPG setup; represent isolation, metering, compliance evidence and fault behaviour, no invented gas lines

checks.title: Structural footing, loads, wind and roof
checks.sourceObservation: exterior uses box meshes; no structure/design engineering, slab/footings, roof anchorage, imposed loads, NSW wind/climate or fire resistance documentation
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Create building-design assumptions and synthetic engineering metadata, verify spanning/structure/cladding, wind and storm loading and structural documentation before claims

checks.title: Fire compartmentation and upper-floor access
checks.sourceObservation: external upper glazing implies further level but interior has no first floor, stairs, lift, fire-separation/cool-room compliance analysis
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Establish actual number of usable floors; if a real upper storey exists design stairs/access and consider fire compartmentation and egress, or treat façade as explicitly decorative

checks.title: Indoor acoustic, odour and environmental impacts
checks.sourceObservation: pub, fireplace, lounge and patron activity in game; no calculated plant noise, exhaust or adjacent-premise noise controls
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Check consent/licence noise limits and hours, plant/exhaust positions and neighbour impacts; supply fictional controls without asserting real site permit

checks.title: Energy efficiency and insulation
checks.sourceObservation: visual ceiling, fans, cooler but no measured thermal envelope or NCC Section J equipment/controls/energy demand
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Assess relevant NCC Section J for actual work/classification and create declared energy/insulation/HVAC loads consistent with electricity game model

checks.title: Emergency access, evacuation and staff procedure
checks.sourceObservation: no pub-specific evacuation plan, staff alarm action, evacuation muster/signage or fire-and-rescue access route in scene
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Model credible staff response, guest egress, muster and evacuation routes without claiming game is fire-safety guidance

checks.title: Hotel liquor licence conditions, free water, food availability
checks.sourceObservation: bar and meals menu are represented and fictional open hours 11:00–23:00; no documented licence/licensee display, free-water interaction or hours/conditions evidence
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Represent NSW hotel licence or chosen appropriate licence, displayed name/licensee, free drinkable water whenever alcohol served and suitable food supply; verify venue-specific approvals

checks.title: Responsible service, minors and designated areas
checks.sourceObservation: hotspot prose says 'publican serves responsibly' but no age check, RSA workflow, refusal service or minors-authorised floor zones
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Add ID/RSA and refusal logic, minor access zone rules, licensed floor boundaries and front/counter signage only as relevant to actual approvals

checks.title: TAB/Keno signage and gaming boundary
checks.sourceObservation: TAB/Keno screen is decorative; no gaming machine meshes (not the same as a TAB/Keno screen), authorisations or responsible gaming controls
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Keep Keno/TAB separate from poker machine requirements; if gameplay gaming is added implement authorisations, age checks, responsible gambling rules and any separate room design

checks.title: Food registration, Food Regulation 2025 and FSS
checks.sourceObservation: lamb/pie/veg menu and supply economics exist; no Council food registration, Food Safety Supervisor, food handler training or evidence of safe food controls
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Represent notified retail food premises, food supervisor certificates (fictional), training and 3.2.2A checks, lawful temperatures and food safety inspection history

checks.title: Allergen information, traceability and food handling logs
checks.sourceObservation: menu gives general dishes but no ingredient allergen disclosures, storage traceability, raw/cooked separation or temperature evidence
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Add allergen menu interaction, ingredient/substitution controls, supplier lots, critical control monitoring and no false dietary guarantees

checks.title: Separate water/sewer/fire/public utility dependencies
checks.sourceObservation: pub lights have power callback but electrical asset registry lacks physical service, and water/sewer systems are aggregate game stocks
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Connect all fixtures and plant equipment to real game services and test water/power/sewer outage effects; don't double count fictional water and sanitary streams

checks.title: Measured acceptance, access and legal-review gate
checks.sourceObservation: existing shop interior tests assert one room, colliders and reachable hotspots, not structural/egress/toilet/food/fire or legal certification
checks.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Add measured build spec, detailed floor plan, game 3D/mobile walk test, all relevant NCC/PCA/food/liquor checks, independent qualified design review; never mark formally certified using code tests

limitations: No actual planning/occupation approvals or fire safety schedule viewed.
A game mesh absence is not proof of a physical building code breach.
Legal requirements and exact fixture/exit thresholds depend on approved class/use, occupancy and building work scope.
No in-game site walk or live browser test performed.
Current world coordinates and scene dimensions may use separate representation scales requiring reconciliation.
